sources.gradient2: margulies2016 fcgradient02 fsLR32k, fixed published sign
sources.thickness: hcps1200 thickness fsLR32k, released group map
sources.geometry: fsLR32k stored sphere pointset coordinates; no coordinate transform or resampling
sources.independent_people: not inferred from parcels, rotations or release name

parcellation.parcel_ids: exact integers 1 through 400, ascending canonical order
parcellation.join: CIFTI BrainModelAxis brain_structure and zero-based local hemisphere vertex ID to full GIFTI rows
parcellation.support: nonzero cortical labels; preserve all 400 nonempty hemisphere-pure parcels; fail on noncortical nonzero labels
parcellation.zero_label: excluded; unrepresented cortical vertices excluded; finite zero map values retained
parcellation.nonfinite: fail on included vertices; no imputation or map-dependent parcel exclusion
parcellation.reduction: float64 arithmetic means in ascending original local vertex-ID order
parcellation.centroid: float64 coordinate mean, divided by its L2 norm, multiplied by 100; zero/nonfinite mean fails
parcellation.support_digest: SHA256(b'MAPREL_support_v2\n' + hemisphere ASCII L/R + b'\n' + ascending local vertex IDs as little-endian int64 bytes)
parcellation.support_digest_join_bytes: prefix bytes, one ASCII L or R byte, one 0a newline byte, then vertex int64 bytes
parcellation.hemisphere: 0=left,1=right from BrainModelAxis, never inferred from parcel number or flattened position

spin.coordinates: canonical authenticated source centroids only, not serialized geometry receipts
spin.rng: private legacy NumPy RandomState seeded once; consecutive normal(3,3) matrices including rejected candidates
spin.rotation: Q,R=NumPy QR; Q=Q@diag(sign(diag(R))); flip first Q column if det(Q)<0
spin.right_rotation: D@Q@D where D=diag(-1,1,1), using the same left rotation

assignment.vasa: Euclidean distance_matrix(coordinates,coordinates@rotation); repeatedly first-index argmax(row minimum), first-index argmin in that row; remove row/column
assignment.hungarian: SciPy linear_sum_assignment of the same Euclidean distance matrix

spin.ties: pinned library choices on canonical sorted parcel IDs; Vasa first-index ties; no claim of a unique scientific assignment
spin.duplicate_policy: check_duplicates=True: reject complete identity or a previous full assignment for at most500 candidates per column; retain candidate500 even if duplicate; RNG advances on every candidate; preserve upstream warning condition
spin.orientation: rotate/remap gradient2 against fixed thickness; spin entries are literal source parcel IDs at destination rows
spin.null_support: keep all declared rotations, including repeats and undefined correlations; no outcome-dependent regeneration

numerics.relative_fidelity_scope: both observed maps and every canonically active remapped gradient; no absolute floor
numerics.activity: canonical exact constant is inactive; otherwise scale by max absolute value, subtract fsum(values)/N in scaled units, active iff stable L2>0; no map-unit cutoff
numerics.centered_fidelity: center accepted and source at their common maximum absolute scale; stableL2(centered difference)/stableL2(centered source)
numerics.pearson: scale-first fsum centering and fsum dot, stable scaled L2 norms; recenter each actual remapped gradient; clamp only roundoff within1e-12 of [-1,1]
numerics.replay_authority: one replay of accepted signed source-bound parcel values, never a hidden source p or rounded null receipt
numerics.undefined: inactive canonical observed map or remap produces null r with explicit status; any required undefined statistic makes exceedance/numerator/p/significance null, retaining denominator N+1 and all slots
numerics.exceedance: E=sum(abs(replayed null r)>=abs(replayed observed r)); inclusive exact comparator, no tie epsilon
numerics.exact_fields: source identities, support hashes/counts, mapped IDs, rotation membership, statuses, inference counts and Boolean decisions

interpretation.allowed_outcomes: any correctly computed signed effect, p and significance decision
interpretation.limits: conditional on fixed group maps, support and chosen centroid assignment; spatial structure is approximated, not an unconditional null-calibration proof; non-rejection does not establish absence or causality
